purpose: Resolve a Pennsylvania business to one strong registry entity, geocode a caller-supplied origin address and the source-published registry address, and compare straight-line Census-coordinate distance with a caller-supplied radius.

decision_policy.within_radius: Both addresses Census-match and straight-line coordinate distance is at or below maxDistanceMiles.
decision_policy.outside_radius: Both addresses Census-match and straight-line coordinate distance is above maxDistanceMiles.
decision_policy.company_not_found: No Pennsylvania registry entity candidate was found.
decision_policy.human_review: Registry/address evidence is unavailable, uncertain, incomplete, or cannot be geocoded.

claim_boundaries: distance is straight-line great-circle distance between Census geocoder coordinates, not driving distance or travel time
the registry address is source-published public registration data and does not prove current operations or physical control
within_radius is only a caller-defined geographic policy result and does not prove local ownership, service area, residency, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal compliance
